notes.title: The Operational Art of War IV is out on Steam
notes.content:
One of the deepest wargame ever made, encompassing over 100 years of conflicts all around the globe, with more than 300 playable scenarios has been released on Steam! 

The Operational Art of War IV it’s a wargame like no other. It will make you relive the most iconic battles from the dawn of the 20th Century to modern day, from the Battle of Marne, Dien Bien Phu, the Batte of Arnhem, to the Falkland Invasion, Desert Storm and beyond. 

Today, the developers are proud to announce that this innovative masterpiece has been brought to Steam! 

Are you ready to push your strategic skills to the limits? 

Grab The Operational Art of War IV now 

New to the game? Watch this series of amazing videos and tutorials! 

www.youtube.com/watch?v=yjv9ku_fjN4&feature=youtu.be&list=PLk5K-IfEIqTtb2XCumq4JyFFifnDA6Rr-

Don’t miss the stream today at 6 PM BST time on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url]

notes.title: The Operational Art of War goes on Steam this month!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738466/896573fcf038cf37f9dd482fbef3658ba6d00a2b.jpg[/img]

The [b]Operational Art of War IV[/b], the new generation of operational wargames, [b]will be released on Steam on October 15th![/b]

Players will be pleased to know that the huge number of scenarios and content will be integrated with the [b]Steam Workshop[/b] tool. 

With an unmatched level of flexibility and with a new array of exciting features, The Operational Art of War IV will make you relive the most iconic battles from the dawn of the 20th Century to modern day, including the ones that never occurred!

To properly celebrate this important achievement, [b]The Operational Art of War IV[/b] will have a Steam [b]Twitch Stream on October 15th at 6PM BST[/b] on our official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url]
